wintab32.dll and wintab_core.h come from the macOS project:
https://github.com/ametrien/Paint-Tool-SAI-pen-pressure-macOS-fix
commit d050548 (2026-11-27), folder wintab-src/
(the timelapse records the document SAI's window title names, not the one
opened last, and notes in C:\sai-timelapse\documents.txt which file each
document was opened from and saved to; on top of c26c44c, the rereads that
read every tile). That commit is not on GitHub yet.

The DLL is an x86-64 Windows DLL. It runs inside Wine in the app and reads pen
samples on UDP 127.0.0.1:47800.
Licence: GNU GPL version 3 with additional terms, see LICENSE and NOTICE here.

wintab_core.h is only used by tests/test_android_wire.c, which checks that the
DLL's own parser reads the lines the app sends.
